blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Networks that predict angles, gaze directions, and rotations do not output these quantities directly: they emit raw coordinates that a fixed decoder, such as normalization, maps to the final prediction. Attribution methods are usually applied to the raw coordinates, so they can credit inputs for changes the decoder discards, such as rescaling a vector when only its direction matters. The resulting explanation can highlight inputs that have no effect on the prediction. We instead attribute through the decoder differential, which for normalization decoders reduces to a scaled tangent projection. We characterize invariance to output rescaling, show that every fixed smooth scalar target on a sphere has points of zero tangential sensitivity, and show that an endpoint-projected variant of Integrated Gradients can still attribute to scale-only inputs, whereas direct angular Integrated Gradients cannot. On synthetic tasks with analytically known relevance, ambient attribution assigns up to 72% of its mass to an irrelevant region. On MPIIGaze validation data, tangent Grad-CAM produces 44% greater prediction displacement under 10% pixel deletion. On PASCAL3D+ with a 6D rotation decoder, the full differential improves mean deletion displacement by 14.1 degrees over the ambient coordinate sum and by 13.8 degrees over a decoder-invariant scalar. Results for a two-polarity tangent LayerCAM variant are mixed: it exceeds ambient-sum LayerCAM on circular regression but no difference is detected on quaternion pose. These results separate two failure sources, radial contamination and scalarization loss. The approach uses existing attribution methods with decoder-aware targets, although some variants also require changes to attribution aggregation. An invariant attribution can still miss inputs that drive the prediction, so invariance and deletion performance should each be checked.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Attribution methods explain a model’s prediction by scoring how much each input feature, such as each pixel of an image, contributed to it. Grad-CAM [ 17 ] , LIME [ 15 ] , and Integrated Gradients (IG) [ 18 ] are widely used examples, and practitioners rely on the resulting heatmaps to debug models and detect spurious features.
blocks.zh: 分配方法通过评分每个输入特性,如图像的每个像素,对模型的预测做出了多大的贡献来解释模型的预测. Grad-CAM [17],LIME [15],以及集成梯度(IG) [18] 被广泛使用的例子,从业者依靠由此产生的热图来调试模型并检测虚假特征.

blocks.en: Each method explains a single scalar target, which in classification is naturally the predicted class score. For networks that predict angles, gaze directions, or 3D rotations, the usual target is formed from raw output coordinates, and we show that this can highlight inputs with provably no effect on the prediction.
blocks.zh: 每种方法都解释一个单一的scalar目标,在分类中这自然是预测的班级分数. 对于预测角度,凝视方向,或3D旋转的网络,通常的目标从原始输出坐标形成,我们显示这可以突出输入,对预测没有明显的影响.

blocks.en: The cause is a gap between what the network emits and what it predicts, and it produces two problems. First, a network layer can only emit a vector in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} , so the designer adds a fixed, parameter-free decoder: circular regression reads an angle from a plane vector, gaze and surface-normal models normalise a vector, and pose models project four, six, or nine numbers onto a rotation. The emitted coordinates have more degrees of freedom than the prediction, so many of them denote the same output: z z and 2 ​ z 2z name the same direction. Attribution methods are nevertheless applied to the coordinates. An input that only changes the length of a gaze vector then receives credit, even though the decoder discards length entirely. Second, even when the network normalises its own output so that the length carries no sensitivity, a fixed scalar such as the coordinate sum registers change in the prediction along only one direction, and inputs that move the prediction in other directions go under-credited.
blocks.zh: 其原因在于网络的释放和预测之间的空隙,它会产生两个问题. 首先,一个网络层只能在 R n\ mathb{R}^{n} 中释放一个矢量, 所以设计者会添加一个固定的,无参数的解码器: 循环回归从平面矢量读取一个角度, 凝视和表面正常的模型使矢量正常化,并将模型项目4, 6, 或 9 个数字置入旋转中. 所发射的坐标比预测的自由度更高,因此其中很多表示相同的输出:z z和 2 z 2z 命名相同的方向. 然而,坐标适用归属方法。 一个只改变视线向量长度的输入,然后获得信用,即使解码器完全丢弃长度. 第二,即使网络使自己的输出正常化,使长度不带敏感度,像坐标和等固定的标尺只沿一个方向变化预测,而将预测移到其他方向的投入则信用不足。

Existing attribution methods can use decoder-aware targets, but retaining the full differential can require multiple backward passes and vector-valued aggregation; the two-polarity LayerCAM variant also changes polarity aggregation. blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Standard attribution methods explain a scalar target derived from the network output, whether by back-propagation (Grad-CAM [ 17 ] , HiResCAM [ 5 ] , LayerCAM [ 9 ] ), surrogate fitting (LIME [ 15 ] , SHAP [ 12 ] ), path integration (IG [ 18 ] ), or perturbation (occlusion [ 22 ] , RISE [ 14 ] ). Work on regression keeps the scalar-output assumption [ 10 ] . Govi et al. [ 7 ] adapt Grad-CAM to rotation regression and report difficulty selecting feature maps, which we read as an instance of the decoder-null issue. Manifold IG [ 21 ] , Riemannian IG [ 4 ] and least-resistance paths [ 16 ] make IG geometry-aware on the input side; we place the manifold on the output side, and the two compose.
blocks.zh: 标准归属方法解释从网络输出中衍生出来的标尺目标,无论是背向传播(Grad-CAM [17],HiResCAM [5],TyleCAM [9]),代装(LIME [15],SHAP [12]),路径集成(IG [18]),还是扰动(插入[22],RISE [14]). 回归工作保持了scalar-output的假设[10]. 高维等. [7] 调整 Grad-CAM 以适应旋转回归,并报告选择特征图的困难,我们把它读作解码器-null问题的例子. Manifold IG [21], Riemannian IG [4] 和最不抵抗路径 [16] 使IG几何-意识到输入侧;我们把多面放在输出侧,两个构图.

blocks.en: We evaluate in two settings. On synthetic tasks we know by construction which pixels matter, so attribution can be scored against ground truth. On real tasks, ground-truth feature relevance is unavailable, so we measure how far the prediction moves when the highest-ranked pixels are removed.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种情况下进行评估。 在合成任务方面,我们通过构造知道什么像素很重要,所以归属可以和地面的真理相对分. 在实际任务上,地面真实特征的关联性是不存在的,因此我们测量了在删除最高级像素时预测的移动程度.

blocks.en: Metrics. Oracle attribution mass ratio (AMR) is the fraction of absolute attribution mass that falls on the region known to be relevant (1.0 is perfect, 0.5 is chance). Deletion displacement measures how far the prediction moves in geodesic distance after setting a specified fraction of pixels, ranked by | ϕ i | |\phi_{i}| , to zero in all channels in raw [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] space. Mean deletion displacement averages this quantity over the nine deletion fractions 10%, 20%, …, 90%. Higher is better: the attribution found pixels the prediction depends on. Units are hours on S 1 S^{1} and degrees on S 2 S^{2} and SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{SO}(3) . Directional consistency (DCS) tests whether the sign of an attribution is meaningful. On S 1 S^{1} we delete each of the 100 most positively attributed pixels in turn and report the fraction for which the prediction moves against the attributed direction (chance 0.5). Changes are wrapped to [ − 12 , 12 ) [-12,12) h; zero changes count as failures, and scores pool pixel deletions. Counts and the scoring formula are in Appendix Q . On S 2 S^{2} we instead report the cosine between the attributed tangent direction and the negative of the observed tangential displacement. Completeness checks that path-integrated attributions sum to the change in the target each method is defined to explain. Implementation details are in Appendix Q .

blocks.en: Synthetic oracles. Each 64 × 64 64\times 64 image has two halves. Region A encodes the direction to be predicted. Region B encodes only a magnitude, which sets the length of the output vector and is discarded by the decoder. The two halves pass through disjoint network branches, so region B provably cannot change the decoded prediction, and any attribution it receives is an error. We build one such task for each of S 1 S^{1} , S 2 S^{2} and SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{SO}(3) , the last with rotations represented as unit quaternions on S 3 S^{3} . Table 1 uses n = 500 / 30 / 200 n=500/30/200 test images respectively. The entangled controls, in which a single network sees both regions, use n = 200 n=200 on S 1 S^{1} and S 2 S^{2} , and a separately trained, wider-range stratified oracle supplies the n = 2,000 n=2{,}000 alignment analysis (Appendix I.2 ). Construction details are in Appendix L .

blocks.en: Plant ( S 1 S^{1} ). The task is to predict the time of day from a plant image. The dataset has 3,765 masked plant images, split 2,621/767/377 into train, validation and test with each recording session kept in a single split. We train four backbones, each ending in a linear layer with two outputs followed by tanh. Attribution is computed for one checkpoint per backbone on the validation split, which was also used to select that checkpoint; accuracy is reported on the held-out test split. To delete a pixel we set it to zero in all channels, the background value of the pre-masked images; Appendix E varies the IG integration baseline.

blocks.en: In the synthetic oracle the two network branches see disjoint pixels, so the derivative of the decoded prediction with respect to every region- B B pixel is exactly zero. Any attribution placed on region B B is therefore an error, and a method that respects the decoder should score an AMR of 1.
blocks.zh: 在合成甲骨文中,两个网络分支都看到脱节像素,因此解码预测对每个区域的衍生——B像素完全为零. 因此,B区的任何归属都是一个错误,尊重解码器的方法应得1分的AMR.

blocks.en: Tangent projection scores at least 0.9996 on all three manifolds (Table 1 ), which confirms that the measurement works. Ambient attribution scores far lower. With Grad-CAM its AMR is 0.498 on S 1 S^{1} , no better than chance, and 0.281 on S 2 S^{2} , below chance: on S 2 S^{2} , 72% of the attribution mass lies on pixels that cannot affect the prediction.

blocks.en: The radial control shows where that mass comes from. Projecting the gradient onto the radial direction, the one the decoder discards, gives AMR ≤ 0.0005 \mathrm{AMR}\leq 0.0005 , so nearly all of its mass lands on region B B . The ambient weight adds the squared tangential and radial components (§ 2.2 ), so its map is a mixture of the two and its AMR falls between them. This is the radial contamination of failure mode 1, measured directly (Figure S2 , Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 光圈控制显示质量来自哪里 将梯度投射到射线方向上,即解码器丢弃物,给AMR 0.0005\mathrm{AMR}\leq 0.0005,因此它几乎所有的质地都位于B区. 环境重量增加了方形的微小和光圈成分(§2.2),因此其地图是两者的混合物,其AMR落在它们之间. 这是直接测量的故障模式1的光圈污染(图S2,附录A)。

blocks.en: Circular and spherical LIME score 0.823–0.946, most of the way to the tangent result. Ambient scores are higher on S 3 S^{3} (0.747–0.757) than on the other two manifolds. The area occupied by region A A does not account for this and we have not identified the cause, so we report the differences across manifolds without interpreting them.

blocks.en: In § 5 the prediction-relevant and decoder-null information sit in disjoint pixels and pass through separate branches. When a single network sees both regions instead (the entangled controls, Appendix D ), the failure almost disappears: the tangent, ambient, and radial variants of Grad-CAM and HiResCAM differ by at most 0.007 AMR within each method and manifold. Saliency differs more, by 0.067 on S 1 S^{1} and 0.056 on S 2 S^{2} . The two architectures also differ in depth, pooling, and parameter count, however, so this comparison cannot show that sharing is the cause. We therefore vary the amount of sharing inside one architecture.
blocks.zh: 在§5中,预测相关和解码器-null信息坐落在不连接的像素中,并通过单独的分支. 当一个单一的网络看到两个区域(缠绕的控制,附录D),失败几乎消失:Grad-CAM和HiResCAM的切变、环境变异和射线变异在每种方法和多种方法内最多为0.007 AMR。 在S1 S^{1}和S2 S^{2}的0.056上, 然而,这两个架构在深度,集合,参数计数上也有所不同,因此这一比较不能显示共享是原因. 因此,我们改变在一个架构内共享的数量。

blocks.en: 6.2 Representation Sharing Modulates the Failure
blocks.zh: 6.2 代表分享

blocks.en:
We train 5 seeds at each of 7 values of α \alpha (35 runs, all converged). For each run we compute the AMR gap, defined as tangent AMR minus ambient-gradient-magnitude AMR, using input-gradient saliency on 100 test images per run. The gap shrinks steadily as sharing increases, from + 0.633 +0.633 at α = 0 \alpha=0 to + 0.395 +0.395 at α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 (Figure 2 ). The condition means are close to linear in α \alpha ( r = − 0.997 r=-0.997 , p = 6.6 × 10 − 7 p=6.6\times 10^{-7} ), and the decline is monotone in 4 of 5 individual seeds. It is also significant at the seed level, both for the per-seed slope ( t ⁡ ( 4 ) = − 7.49 t(4)=-7.49 , p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ) and in a within-seed permutation test ( p = 5.0 × 10 − 6 p=5.0\times 10^{-6} ; k = 0 k=0 of 200,000 relabellings; Appendix I ).
The α = 0 \alpha=0 gap is a mean over five saliency runs. It differs from the saliency entry in Table 1 (ambient AMR 0.428, gap 0.572) because the trained models and test images differ.

blocks.en: Tangent AMR is exactly 1.000 at every α \alpha , as first-order invariance requires (§ 2.1 ). Radial AMR rises from 0.000 to 0.390 as the magnitude head starts to read region- A A features, and ambient attribution, which mixes the tangent and radial components, rises with it. Model accuracy does not explain the trend: we detect no association between angular error and α \alpha ( r = − 0.25 r=-0.25 , p = 0.15 p=0.15 ). The effect also replicates with HiResCAM (gap 0.541 → 0.238 0.541\to 0.238 ).
blocks.zh: 紧凑的AMR在每α-α中恰好是1 000,按照一阶变化的要求(第2.1节)。 放射性AMR从0.000升至0.390,因为星头开始读取区域——A特征,环境归属,将正和射线成分混合在一起,随它而上升。 模型精度并不能解释这个趋势:我们检测到角误差与α\α(r = − 0.25 r = - 0.25,p = 0.15 p = 0.15)之间没有关联,效果也与HiResCAM(gap 0.541 → 0.38 0.541\to 0.238)复制.

blocks.en: Sharing reduces the failure without removing it. The gap falls by 38% over the tested range, and the decline is still approximately linear at α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 , leaving the gap well above the near-zero level of the entangled controls. The sweep therefore shows that sharing modulates the failure.
blocks.zh: 共享可以减少故障而不移除. 差距在测试范围上下降了38%,在α = 0.9\alpha = 0.9 时仍呈约线性下降,使差距远高于缠绕控制器的近零水平. 因此,扫描显示共享可以调节失败.

blocks.en: Three diagnostics computed on the trained model track the gap within this sweep, but none is yet validated as a predictor on real architectures (Appendix I.1 ). On quaternion pose, lower scalar-target alignment is associated with a larger deletion gap, but low alignment also coincides with harder poses, so the association does not isolate the cause (Appendix I.2 ).

blocks.en: On validation participant p13 ( n = 2,996 n=2{,}996 ), across five ResNet18 seeds, tangent Grad-CAM produces 44% greater displacement than ambient-sum Grad-CAM at 10% deletion, in every seed ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: Attribution maps are used to debug models and detect spurious features, and for structured outputs the usual target can undermine both uses. A heatmap computed on raw coordinates can highlight inputs that cannot change the prediction, sending a practitioner after features the model does not use. On synthetic tasks where the irrelevant inputs are known by construction, the ambient methods we tested place 24–72% of their attribution mass on such inputs (§ 5 ). Across 35 controlled runs, this error shrinks as the two pathways share more of their representation (§ 6 ). The approach requires no model retraining. It adapts existing attribution methods with decoder-aware targets, while some variants require multiple backward passes or changes to attribution aggregation. The real tasks reveal a second problem beyond radial contamination: scalarisation loss. The gaze and quaternion heads normalise their output, leaving no radial sensitivity to remove, yet a single scalar target still sees only one direction in which the prediction can move. On 6D pose the full differential beats both scalar targets, including the decoder-invariant one. Decoder invariance therefore says what an attribution means, not how well it performs under deletion, and the two should be checked separately. Our gains are limited to the comparisons reported. On quaternion pose the ResNet50 result is inconclusive, and the two-polarity tangent variant shows no detectable difference from ambient-sum LayerCAM. On S 1 S^{1} that variant scores higher on every checkpoint, but it also changes polarity aggregation and is not seed-replicated. Direct AIG is complete for the lifted angle, but its unsigned mean displacement stays close to standard IG and the reliability of its sign varies.
blocks.zh: 归属图被用于调试模型和检测虚假特征,对于结构化输出,通常的目标可以破坏这两种用途. 在原始坐标上计算出的热图可以突出无法改变预测的投入,在模型未使用特性后发送一个从业者。 在合成任务中,如果建筑工程知道不相关的投入,我们测试的环境方法将24-72%的归属质量放在这些投入上(第5节)。 在35个可控运行中,这一差错有所缩小,因为这两个路径分享了它们更多的代表性(第6节)。 这种做法不需要模式再培训。 它将现有的归属方法与解码器-意识目标相适应,而一些变体则需要多个后传或改变归属聚合. 真正的任务揭示了射线污染以外的第二个问题:缩小损失。 视线和四角线头使输出正常化,没有光圈敏感度去除,然而,一个光圈目标仍然只看到预测可以移动的一个方向. 在6D上,完全差值会击败两个scalar目标,包括解码器-内变器. 因此,解码器的偏差表示归属意味着什么,而不是在删除后表现如何,两者应分别检查。 我们的收益仅限于报告的比较。 在四角线上,ResNet50的结果是没有结果的,两极切值变体表明,与环境-和层CAM没有可探测的区别。 在S1 SQQQ1}上,这个变体在每个检查站的得分都更高,但也改变了极性聚合,而不是种子复制. 对于升空角度,直接AIG是完整的,但其未署名的平均值迁移仍然接近标准IG,其标志的可靠性也各不相同.

blocks.en: Future work should extend the real-task evaluation beyond the three tasks and single dataset per task studied here, and replicate across seeds the S 1 S^{1} attribution experiments and S 2 S^{2} perturbation baselines. Extending tasks with analytically known relevance beyond synthetic images would allow the cases where deletion rankings and decoder invariance disagree (Appendix O.1 ) to be resolved against ground truth.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应当将实际任务评价扩大到本文研究的三项任务和单一数据集之外,并在种子中复制S1 S^{1}归属实验和S2 S^{2}扰动基线。 将分析上已知的关联性任务扩大到合成图像之外,将使删除排位和编解变化不一致的情况(附录O.1)能够根据地面真相得到解决。

blocks.en: Under a black baseline on pre-masked images, ( x − x ′ ) ≈ x (x-x^{\prime})\approx x , assigning zero attribution to about 90% of pixels by construction and inflating deletion AUC for the IG family relative to gray and blur baselines (ResNet18 direct AIG deletion AUC under the normalised metric: 7.79h black, 0.91h gray, 6.16h blur, 4.36h distributional). The gray value collapses for the mirror-image reason: on a pre-masked image a gray baseline makes ( x − x ′ ) ≈ − 0.5 (x-x^{\prime})\approx-0.5 over the whole blanked background, so IG spreads attribution across background pixels whose replacement by a black deletion baseline leaves their values unchanged. Directional consistency is far more stable across baselines (ResNet18 direct AIG: 59.4% black, 60.1% gray, 59.9% blur, 65.3% distributional), which is why we treat DCS as the primary evaluation metric for signed attribution and blur as the default IG integration baseline. Deletion sets selected pixels to zero for every row of this ablation.

The reference images, in raw [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] space, are black ( x ′ = 0 x^{\prime}=0 ), gray ( x ′ = 0.5 x^{\prime}=0.5 ), Gaussian blur (kernel size 29, σ = 29 \sigma=29 pixels), and distributional (IG averaged over reference images drawn from other validation images). blocks.en: The ambient-sum column reproduces Draelos & Carin [ 5 ] , whose §3.6.2 proof covers GAP followed by a single fully connected layer. Our head is Linear ⁡ ( d , 2 ) + tanh \operatorname{Linear}(d,2)+\tanh , which differs in two ways, and the equivalence survives both. The tanh is elementwise and applied after the linear layer, contributing a per-output scalar factor that is spatially constant and cancels under normalization. More substantively, our attribution is the tangent projection (the coefficient in § 3.1 ), a linear combination of two output gradients whose coefficients ( y ^ cos , − y ^ sin ) (\hat{y}_{\cos},-\hat{y}_{\sin}) are per-image constants, so spatial constancy is preserved and the collapse extends to the tangent-projected variants, which their proof does not cover.
blocks.zh: 环境和分栏复制了Draelos & Carin [5],其第3.6.2节的证明涵盖GAP,然后是单一的全连接层. 我们的头是 Linear + (d, 2) + tanh\ operatorname{ Linear} (d, 2) → tanh, 它在两个方面是不同的, 等值同时存在。 tanh是元素化的,在线性层之后应用,产生一个空间恒定且在正常化下取消的每输出分级系数. 更实质性地说,我们的归属是切值预测(第3.1节中的系数),是两个输出梯度的线性组合,其系数(y ^ cos, - y ^ sin)(\hat{y}_{\cos}, -\hat{y}_{\sin})是偶象常数,因此空间恒定性得到保留,崩塌性延伸至切值预测的变体,它们的证据没有涵盖这些变体.

blocks.en: The masking-boundary confound. Plant pixels occupy about 1.3% of a masked image on average, and 25–39% of attribution mass falls on the boundary band rather than on plant interiors, suggesting the model may exploit the segmentation edge (which correlates with camera angle and hence time) as a shortcut. Retraining on aggressively edge-softened images did not degrade accuracy (1.29h vs. 1.41h, single seed each), so the sharp edge is not necessary. But every faithfulness measure collapsed (DCS for tangent Grad-CAM 0.487 → 0.176 0.487\to 0.176 , with deletion AUC falling as well). This is genuinely ambiguous: softening removes the mask artifact but also blurs real leaf margins, which plausibly inform leaf angle. A drop in deletion AUC is consistent both with "the artifact carried the attribution" and with "we destroyed real signal." Distinguishing them requires a mask perturbation leaving leaf structure intact, which we have not built.
blocks.zh: 蒙面边际惑. 植物像素平均占据约1.3%,25-39%的归属质量落在边界带而不是植物内部,这表明模型可能利用分层边缘(它与相机角度和时间相关)作为捷径。 对剧烈边缘变软的图像的再训练并没有降低精度(1.29h对1.41h,每个种子为单种),所以锋利的边缘没有必要. 但每一项忠诚度措施都崩溃了(正切Grad-CAM 0.487 → 0.176 0.487\= 0.176,删除的AUC 也下降)。 这实在是模棱两可:软化除去面具文物,但也模糊了真正的叶边,这为叶角提供了合理的信息. 删掉AUC的下降既符合"文物携带的归属",也符合"我们摧毁了真正的信号". 区分它们需要一个面具扰动 离开叶子结构完好无损, 我们没有建造。

blocks.en: We do not read this as showing that the deletion metric is wrong. Deletion measures the change in the decoded prediction after a finite input perturbation, and a map built for an ambient coordinate can still select pixels that move the decoded prediction, particularly when scale and angle depend on shared features. A local gradient map can also score lower on finite deletion because of saturation, nonlinear effects, feature interactions or masking artifacts. What the table shows is a disagreement between an attribution’s invariance property and its finite-perturbation ranking; establishing that the metric itself fails would require independent ground truth, which only the oracles provide.
blocks.zh: 我们不认为这是显示删除指标是错误的。 删除测量在有限输入扰动后解码预测的变化,为环境坐标构建的地图仍然可以选择移动解码预测的像素,特别是在尺度和角度依赖于共享特征时. 由于饱和,非线性效应,特征相互作用或遮掩文物,局部梯度图在有限删除上也可以得分较低. 该表显示,一个归属的固有财产与其有限-扰动排名之间存在分歧;确定衡量标准本身的失败需要独立的地面真相,只有神谕提供这种真相。

blocks.en: Five ResNet18 gaze models were trained from independent initialisations on the identical leave-one-person-out split; attribution uses validation participant p13 ( n = 2,996 n=2,996 ), also used for epoch selection (Table S14 ). Tangent Grad-CAM’s advantage over ambient Grad-CAM is concentrated at low deletion fractions, where it is large and reliable: at the 10% fraction tangent reaches 6.50 ± 0.29 ∘ 6.50\pm 0.29{}^{\circ} against 4.52 ± 0.36 ∘ 4.52\pm 0.36{}^{\circ} , 44% larger deletion displacement, favouring tangent in 5 / 5 5/5 seeds ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 , paired over seeds). The advantage holds at p < 0.05 p<0.05 through fraction 0.5 and reverses from 0.8 onward, so the full-range mean ( + 13.5 +13.5 % ± 7.8 \pm 7.8 %, p = 0.017 p=0.017 ) obscures the reversal at high deletion fractions (Figure S1 , Appendix A ). Training variability rather than image sampling is the binding uncertainty: the seed-level 95% interval at 10% is about six times wider than the per-image bootstrap (Appendix B ), and the earlier single-checkpoint improvement in full-range mean deletion AUC (23%) exceeds the corresponding per-seed mean-AUC improvements (5.2% to 22.5%). These percentages use the full range, unlike the 44% gain at fraction 0.1.

This conclusion is limited to the seeded Grad-CAM comparison. The seeded comparison covers tangent and ambient Grad-CAM only; the perturbation baselines (Table S1 , Appendix A ) ran on a single checkpoint, where the original spherical-occlusion estimator leads at fractions 0.1–0.3. The centred estimator (patch 32, stride 16, 169 passes, footprint overlap-add) instead leads tangent Grad-CAM at every fraction: its mean is 11.02 ∘ 11.02^{\circ} , versus 9.37 ∘ 9.37^{\circ} for the original estimator. Both use the same checkpoint, 2,996 p13 images, black fill and unsigned geodesic displacement; grid resolution and patch-to-pixel mapping differ. Appendix A reports all nine centred values. We claim the like-for-like result only: swapping the ambient scalar target for the tangent projection, changing nothing else, gives a reliable early-fraction gain on one backbone and one dataset.

blocks.en: Evaluation covers localisation, direction, and attribution completeness. Synthetic oracles have analytically known relevant and irrelevant regions. Directional metrics assess the sign or direction of prediction changes. Completeness compares attribution sums with a specified target change: the lifted angle for direct angular IG, or the chosen coordinate for ambient IG. Real-task finite-deletion displacement rankings need not agree with decoder invariance (Appendix O ).

blocks.en: Metrics. Directional cosine on S 2 S^{2} : mean cosine between the predicted tangent direction and the negative actual tangential displacement. blocks.en: The 6D head is Linear ( 512 , 6 ) (512,6) , with Gram–Schmidt decoding outside the network in the loss and attribution. Its CAM hook is the last residual block of layer4 ( 512 × 7 × 7 512\times 7\times 7 ), as for quaternion ResNet18.
